title: The greatest spiritual battles rarely happen in public.
paragraphs:
The greatest spiritual battles rarely happen in public.
They happen in your mind.

The enemy doesn't just attack your life —
he attacks your thoughts.
That's why Scripture says to take every thought captive.
Not every thought you hear is truth.
Ever notice how the hardest battles happen inside your head?

Doubt.
Fear.
Temptation.
Negative thoughts that won't stop.
Your mind is the enemy's favorite battlefield.
That's why God tells us to take every thought captive.
Not every voice in your mind deserves authority.
Have you ever struggled with thoughts you knew weren't from God?

You're not alone.
Let's talk about it.
